title: 第22章 暴富第23章 叶桃夭
lines: 百花楼，‘双飞燕’雅间门口。
楼下和旁边房间，各种嚎叫声此起彼伏。
周武听到屋内没有喘叫声，便和身边的周弓闲聊道：“今晚公子怎么这么快就不行了？”
“嘘，小点声！”
周弓食指竖在嘴前，提醒一声，便笑吟吟道，“不过也正常，昨夜公子可是和家主第二百零八房姨太太纠缠了一夜呢。”
“那倒也是，家主忙于治理家族，第二百零八房姨太太备受冷落，风华正茂，正是如狼似虎的年纪呢！”
二人不以为意，低声谈论着主家私房事。
直到第二天正午，百花楼再次热闹非凡时，周武、周弓二人仍不见王麟和‘双飞燕’出房门，也没听到屋内有任何动静，这才意识到不对劲。
“咚咚咚！”
周武拍了拍房门，喊道：“公子，可醒了？该回王府了！”
“公子，属下进来了！”
周武、周弓二人推开房门，看见两双惊恐的目光，瞬间呆住了！
两个裸体女人被捆绑在床架上，目光惊恐。
而他们守护的第九十九公子，脑袋不知去向。
他们完了！
匆忙起身，也不管二女的求救，慌慌张张下楼，离开百花楼。
家主的亲儿子死了，他们死定了！
心里只有一个想法！
逃！
逃得越远越好！
不久后，容妈妈安排人给王麟三人送午膳，侍女看到恐怖的一幕，直接尖叫起来：
“杀人啦！
消息在半天时间内，传遍整个淮湘内城。
“王家第九十九公子，在百花楼被人杀了！”
“没错，就是淮湘城五大势力之一的王家！”
“那凶手可真狠啊，将王公子衣服都扒光了，血都放干了，脑袋至今不知去向！”
“可不是嘛，我兄弟是府衙捕快，据他所说，现场可是没有一滴血。”
凶手这么凶残，不仅取了脑袋，还把血打包带走？”
“谁知道呢？不过这时候，王家家主怕是要气疯了！”
“那倒是，那可是亲儿子，在青楼被取了脑袋，闹得满城皆知！”
一天时间，王家成了城内各大势力的笑谈。
王家，内院正房！
家主王崇明虽然已有八十岁，但其一身锻骨境实力，气血强大，看起来只有四十岁左右。
content_en:
Baihua Building, the entrance to the elegant room of 'Shuang Feiyan'.
All kinds of howls came one after another downstairs and in the next room.
Zhou Wu heard that there was no gasping in the room, so he chatted with Zhou Gong beside him: "Why did the young master fail so quickly tonight?"
"Shh, keep your voice down!"
Zhou Gong raised his index finger in front of his mouth, reminded him, and said with a smile, "But it's normal. Last night, the young master was entangled with the concubine of the 208th house of the house."
"That's true. The head of the family is busy running the family, and the 208th concubine is neglected. She is in her prime, at the age where she is like a wolf and a tiger!"
The two of them didn't take it seriously and whispered about their master's private matters.
It wasn't until noon the next day, when the Baihua Building was bustling again, that Zhou Wu and Zhou Gong still didn't see Wang Lin and 'Shuang Feiyan' come out of the room, nor heard any movement inside the house, so they realized something was wrong.
"Dong dong dong!"
Zhou Wu patted the door and shouted: "Sir, are you awake? It's time to go back to the palace!"
"Sir, my subordinates have come in!"
Zhou Wu and Zhou Gong opened the door and were stunned when they saw two pairs of frightened eyes!
Two naked women were tied to the bed frame, looking horrified.
And the head of the ninety-ninth young master they were guarding was nowhere to be found.
They're finished!
He stood up in a hurry, ignored the two women's pleas for help, and hurriedly went downstairs and left Baihua Building.
The head of the family's biological son is dead, they are dead!
There is only one thought in my mind!
escape!
The further away the better!
Soon after, Rong’s mother arranged for someone to deliver lunch to Wang Lin and the other three. When the maid saw the horrific scene, she screamed:
"Killing!
! "
The news spread throughout the inner city of Huaixiang within half a day.
"The ninety-ninth young master of the Wang family was killed in Baihua Tower!"
"That's right, it's the Wang family, one of the five major forces in Huaixiang City!"
"The murderer was so cruel. He took off all the prince's clothes, drained all his blood, and his head is still missing!"
"Isn't that right? My brother is a government agent. According to what he said, there was not a drop of blood at the scene."
"Hiss!
The murderer was so cruel that he not only took away the head, but also took away the blood in a package? "
"Who knows? But at this time, the head of the Wang family may be going crazy!"
"That's true. He was his own son. His head was taken off in a brothel, and the whole city knew about it!"
In one day, the Wang family became the joke of all the major forces in the city.
Wang family, the main room in the inner courtyard!
Although the head of the family, Wang Chongming, is eighty years old, he has the strength of the Bone Forging Realm and strong Qi and blood. He looks only about forty years old.
